This indicates a chain of molecular interactions where Ergocryptine may influence the activity of these intermediaries, potentially affecting DNA polymerase iota. The scores from the paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the exact mechanism remains unclear. The evidence highlights a possible pathway where Ergocryptine could modulate the activity of upstream targets, which in turn affect DNA polymerase iota. The integration of these pathways underscores the complexity of the molecular interactions involved, emphasizing the need for further experimental validation.
